reviews.title: Poorly designed IO
reviews.comment: I wanted to give this board higher stars but the design of the rear IO is annoying. They added a small hard cmos reset button approximately the size of a c charge cable port, which is what they added directly above and below said reset button. So every single time I miss plugging into the USB c it hard resets, making my ram scan for 20 minutes each time before dumping me to bios for recovery.
reviews.author: Josh
